text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as summer draws near...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...
Is there really anything so special
about
how McQueen runs?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recently, Tokai Teio has been watching
footage
of Mejiro McQueen's races
before training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be trying to find what
McQueen has
that she lacks.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I can definitely tell she's strong,
but it's
not like she's all-powerful or
anything.
choice_data_list: Feel like you're getting the hang ...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, whatever—on to the next one. I've
got a
bunch of her races to watch, so I
gotta get
through them more quickly.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, i-it's nothing...
This is just the race
where she
beat me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I don't need to watch that.
I've already
seen it
firsthand, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After watching a few more replays,
Tokai Teio
gets started with the day's
training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So? Was my time okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, despite losing to Mejiro
McQueen,
Tokai Teio has been running
just fine.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, knew it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So why does Prez think McQueen's
gonna win and
not me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, whatever. It doesn't matter. I need
to focus
on my training!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, can you time me for another
round? I wanna
do it even faster!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her heart still firm, Tokai Teio keeps
training
without losing her positive
attitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is her strength, her forte. What
could she
possibly be missing?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa... McQueen, you're incredible!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: You run so fast, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's just like what everyone's been
saying. You're
back to your old self!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. I'm an entirely different
runner
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you'll excuse me, I'm off to do another
lap.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Now that she mentions it... Ever since
that losing
streak, her whole attitude has
changed.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, her intensity is on a totally
different level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other students have a point. Last
year, despite being considered the top
racer, McQueen
suffered a nasty streak
of losses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her recent change in attitude seems to
stem from
those defeats.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I'm different than who I was
before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
They will all see my ascension. From
earth to the
heavens above...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From her interview, I could sense she
had the
drive to crawl her way back up
from rock bottom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that case, perhaps what Tokai Teio
really lacks
is...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Finished! So what time did I get?
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you didn't even start the clock!
What the
heck are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's with the interrogation all of
a
sudden?
choice_data_list: Were you frustrated by that loss, ...
Were you frustrated by that loss, ...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mean against McQueen? Yeah,
of course.
I was suuuper annoyed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But I can't hang my head forever, you
know? I
gotta surpass Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, forget that! Try actually
timing me this
time, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though the strength not to give in to
frustration
is one of Teio's best features,
it seems to have become her weak point
as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay, time to watch more of McQueen's
races!
You can prep for training while I
do, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As usual, Teio drops by to watch
McQueen's past
replays, but this time I
have a particular race I
want to show her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's this?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't this when I lost to her?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Look, I told you, I've already
experienced this. I
don't need to see it
again!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wh-what? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We raced together. Of course I saw all
of it...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: You're too frustrated to even watc...
You're too frustrated to even watc...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm not frustrated anymore! One loss is

nothing—I'll win the next one and make
up for it
in no time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I can't let frustration hold me
back!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If I give in to it,
then that means I really
was weak!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I have to become good enough to surpass Prez. I have to be stronger!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My words seem to have struck a nerve,
which
proves that there's plenty of
frustration left in
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's just trying to hide it in order
to be
"strong."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Frustration... motivates people?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: B-but, I mean, like I said... I'm not...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But I...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: I'll be right here to back you up!
I'll be right here to support you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time to begin training...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How about now, Trainer? I tried to focus
on my
footing this time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm gonna go for another lap!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Your spirit seems markedly
different
today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, thanks for coming to see me, but I
gotta go
train!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to lose ever again. I don't
want to
ever feel this frustrated again
either!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm off! Keep that stopwatch going,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see. It seems Teio has finally
grasped
what is important.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let that frustration propel you
higher yet,
Teio!
choice_data_list: Teio's only going to get stronger ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio takes the pain within her
heart, turns it
into power, and starts
running once again.
